Kyle Katarn brings a different perspective on

through empathy and feeling, Katarn did so through discipline and will. Skywalker appreciates the difference and Katarn's counsel in matters affecting the Academy. While Luke's journey gives him much wisdom, Kyle's pragmatism and plain speaking offer Luke an alternative viewpoint to consider.

Kyle's life on the fringe puts him in the middle of villains of all stripes. His connections and knowledge of the underbelly of the galaxy serves Skywalker and the Republic well. As the old saying goes, the

only sing when the hull is breached, and Katarn uses his seedy connections to help the Republic anticipate the Imperial Remnant's next move. Kyle relishes missions that send him back to the trenches, and he often takes a student or two along to give them a feeling for life outside the safe confines of the Academy.
